title: A retail store in London
assumptions: A new UK private limited company opening a clothing store, with staff, a fit-out and a sign. VAT applies once turnover passes the threshold; planning permission and advertisement consent apply when the change of use or the sign needs them.

items.name: Company registration with Companies House
items.quote: It costs £100 and can be paid by debit or credit card.

items.name: Corporation Tax registration
items.quote: You will usually be set up for Corporation Tax at the same time,

items.name: VAT registration
items.quote: You must register if your total taxable turnover for the last 12 months goes over £90,000.

items.name: Employer registration (PAYE)
items.quote: You must register before the first payday to get your employer PAYE reference number.

items.name: Workplace pension (automatic enrolment)
items.quote: You must enrol and make an employer’s contribution for all staff who:

items.name: Employers' liability insurance
items.quote: as soon as you become an employer to cover you for at least £5 million from an authorised insurer

items.name: Business rates on the premises
items.agency: Local council (in London, the borough council for the address)
items.quote: Business rates are charged on most non-domestic properties, like:

items.name: Fire risk assessment (no sign-off: the fire authority inspects)
items.quote: carry out a fire risk assessment of the premises and review it regularly

items.name: Planning permission (a change of use or major works)
items.quote: change the use of your building
items.condition: Only when it applies to this opening (see the assumptions).

items.name: Advertisement consent for the shop sign
items.quote: Those which require the express consent of the local planning authority.
items.condition: Only when it applies to this opening (see the assumptions).
